facts_zh:
Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
- Published
A criminal investigation into Argentine President Javier Milei and his sister's links to a cryptocurrency scandal has been dropped.
The case against Milei and his sister Karina Milei was dismissed by federal judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi at the request of prosecutors, court records show.
The Argentinian president had denied promoting the newly launched cryptocoin $Libra , which collapsed shortly after he mentioned it in a social media post in February 2025.

all_titles.en: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud

It said the truce in the "front-line war city on the brink of disaster" without medicine, food and clean water would begin on 29 October.

articles.title_original: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
articles.title_zh: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
facts_zh:
Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
- Published
Ukraine is still recording issues with the Starlink internet network, sources within the defence ministry say, after Donald Trump said limits had been reversed by Elon Musk who owns the satellite system.
The sources told the BBC that instances of drones experiencing connection loss at speeds of 161km/h (100mph) were being recorded, hampering military operations.
The US president had denied instructing the tech billionaire to restrict connectivity to Starlink's military-grade counterpart, Starshield, before saying on Thursday that Musk had "put it back".

all_titles.en: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted

articles.title_zh: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
facts_zh:
Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
- Published
The Israeli military has begun demolishing Palestinian buildings in the city of Hebron, after two Israeli soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said the military would "destroy" the neighbourhood where the two attackers came from, and that Israel was ready for "extensive action" in the occupied West Bank.
Three other soldiers were wounded in the attack at a checkpoint outside Hebron, before the gunmen were shot dead, officials say.

all_titles.en: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead

articles.title_original: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
articles.title_zh: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
facts_zh:
Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
- Published
An oil spill from a tanker attacked near the Strait of Hormuz is spreading along the United Arab Emirates (UAE) coastline, forcing the closure of some beaches and coastal areas.

Satellite images from Monday show the beginnings of the oil spill from a ship matching the location and dimensions of Gem No.2, which was damaged between 9 and 10 October during a record surge of vessel strikes by Iran.
The slick of oil had spread more than 35km (22 miles) from the tanker by Wednesday, the satellite imagery showed.

all_titles.en: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike

articles.title_original: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
articles.title_zh: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
facts_zh: Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.

The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria.
The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.

all_titles.en: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
